plain_english_policy: The option proposes splitting the Immigration and Naturalization Service (INS) into separate bureaus for naturalization and border patrol. This is conventionally viewed as a progressive reform aimed at reducing corruption and improving efficiency within immigration enforcement, aligning with modern administrative reforms rather than restrictive or nativist policies.
evidence_quote: i) Support the separation of the INS into two bureaus: one administering naturalization and one administering border patrol.
